product: Mobile language app that drills the ~800 highest-frequency words through 90-second spoken rounds with mic scoring and a conversation-coverage progress ring

banned_claims: research shows you only need 800 words
banned_topics: proof or research language for the 800-word figure
visa, citizenship or immigration language requirements
brain health, memory or cognitive benefits
pricing not on the current store listing
AI voice cloning of real people
fabricated user quotes or fake DM screenshots
undisclosed partnership (must use #ad in first caption line)
copyrighted music outside the platform commercial library
editing the progress-ring percentage or any in-app number
rules.tone: Grounded, first-person and specific — show the failure then the mechanism, without hype or proof language.

guidance.hook_style: Open in the first 1.5 seconds, spoken and on screen, with a moment of failure — someone who studied a language and still couldn't function in it — before any explanation of the app.
angles: Four years of Spanish and I couldn't order a coffee — school study vs. one real interaction
The 800 list reveal: read the first fifteen words aloud and let their boringness land
Textbook vs. street: course-book phrase vs. what people actually say (great for Japanese and French)
The percentage ring as a scoreboard: day 1 vs. day 11 with real numbers from your own account
I tested it on my flatmate/partner/coworker who actually speaks it (get consent on camera)
Trip countdown: nine days before a holiday, the highest-leverage thing to study
notes: Six and seven slides are the sweet spot; under five underperforms on watch-through and nines only work if slides 4-7 earn their place.
Target 22-38 seconds, vertical 9:16, burned-in captions, no letterboxing.
Explaining the app before the failure moment kills performance every time.
At least one app placement must be a real screen recording of a drill round with audio — no static screenshots or mockups.
The final app placement must show the progress ring with a visible percentage; hold each app frame at least 1.2 seconds.
Say 'Vokabo Core 800' out loud at least once and write it in full in the caption.
Faceless screen-record-plus-voiceover performs as well as talking head.
Generic TTS narration of your own script is allowed but must be disclosed in the caption.
You may say 'frequency lists suggest around 800 words cover most everyday conversation' but not upgrade it to proof language.
Avoid generic '5 apps you need' listicles and AI slideshow travel b-roll with robot voiceover.
Account eligibility: 1,000+ followers, 8+ posts in the last 30 days, account older than 30 days, no follower-purchase history.
Qualified views are organic 3+ second views from native analytics at day 14; paid promotion, bots, pods and repost farms void the post and account.
Submit every post link in #submissions within 24 hours of publishing or it will not be counted.
